card.name: Words just before a medical condition term
card.fires_on: Short linking or partial words in warning text that are about to be followed by a clinical term, such as 'loss of', 'impair the', 'history of vascular', or 'plate|let'. It responds at the point where a condition or body-part word is expected next.

modes.label: Linking words before a symptom
modes.description: A small word such as 'of', 'the' or 'causing' sits right before a symptom or physiological term.
modes.example: paralysis of the legs, loss<< of>> consciousness, respiratory paralysis

modes.label: Partway through blood-related words
modes.description: The pole fires inside a split word such as platelet, leaflet or spherocyte.
modes.example: Concomitant treatment with other inhibitors of plate<<let>> receptor glycoprotein (GP) II

modes.label: Descriptor before a clinical noun
modes.description: An adjective or negation such as 'vascular' or 'non' comes before a clinical term.
modes.example: which may include history of<< vascular>> aneurysm, intracran
